videos.title: If You're Feeling Overwhelmed Watch This
videos.description:
Let this be the last video you watch right now. 

You did not open this app for fun. Something is sitting on you: stress, a worry, plain exhaustion. So your brain reached for the fastest relief it knows, the phone, a modern digital pacifier. And here is the trap: the scroll distracts you FROM the feeling, but it never deals with the feeling. Twenty minutes later the worry is still there, and now your mind is drained on top of it. You paid the energy and kept the problem. And this video is the opposite of a doomscroll. A few minutes to shrink the worry back to its real size, and four quiet words for when it feels too heavy to carry.
